topic: Which vendor should we select for [service/category], and what criteria should drive the decision?
description: Evaluate and select a vendor for a specific service or product category, weighing cost, features, reliability, support, and strategic fit.
investigationInstructions: Define selection criteria: price, features, reliability, support, security, compliance, integration ease.
Identify 3-5 candidate vendors for the service category.
Gather pricing models, contract terms, and hidden costs for each vendor.
Assess vendor track record: uptime, customer reviews, case studies.
Evaluate security and compliance posture (SOC 2, GDPR, data residency).
Consider integration complexity with existing stack.
evidenceRequirements: Vendor shortlist with pricing and feature matrices
expectedOutputStructure: Weighted decision matrix scoring each vendor
Pricing comparison (list price, negotiated, TCO over 3 years)
Risk assessment per vendor (security, lock-in, viability)
